title: 非遗之旅 · 五区示范导览
exhibition_notice: 本展馆为仿真示范策展。展板、造型与停靠点用于讲解演示，不代表任何真实博物馆的馆藏、作者、年代或真伪鉴定；项目知识只引用下列公开来源。到访、掉队、听不清及电量按钮为模拟输入。
exhibition_notice_en: This is a simulated curatorial demonstration. Displays do not identify real museum holdings, artists, dates or authenticity. Visitor and fault inputs are simulated; educational facts are restricted to the listed sources.
knowledge_boundary: 仅回答配置的问题及明确同义问法；无核验来源、价格、鉴定、真实馆藏与个体信息请咨询工作人员。不会联网生成额外答案。

zones.name: 非遗概览区

narrations.child: 【基础】非遗像一份会动的文化礼物。【背景】长辈教给晚辈，再传给下一代。【工艺】不只看做好的物品，也要认识会做的人。【文化】想一想，家里有什么代代相传的歌谣或手艺？
narrations.general: 【基础】非遗包括活着的实践、表达、知识与技能。【背景】联合国教科文组织列出口头传统、表演、社会实践、自然知识和传统手工艺五个领域。【工艺】本示范馆从手艺的过程切入。【文化】不同领域可以相互交织，请尊重实践者的解释。
narrations.deep: 【基础】五个仿真展区是导览路线，并非非遗分类。【背景】我国国家级名录采用十大门类，和公约的五领域框架不同。【工艺】观展时可追问材料、动作与传授方式。【文化】列入名录帮助明确保护对象，不能替代持续学习和实践。

english.child: Basics: Living heritage is a cultural gift we can practise. Background: Older people pass it to younger people. Craft: Look for the maker as well as the object. Culture: What song or skill does your family share?
english.general: Basics: Heritage includes living practices and skills. Background: UNESCO describes five broad domains. Craft: This demonstration follows how skills are practised. Culture: Traditions can cross domains; listen respectfully to their practitioners.
english.deep: Basics: Our five stops are a tour design. Background: China's national inventory uses ten categories, distinct from UNESCO's five domains. Craft: Ask about materials and teaching. Culture: An inventory identifies what needs safeguarding; practice keeps it alive.

zones.task: 找到一个你想学习的手艺，并说明为什么。
zones.task_en: Name one skill you would like to learn and explain why.

quiz.question: 理解非遗，应该同时关注什么？
quiz.question_en: What should we consider when exploring living heritage?

options.text: 实践者及传承的知识技能

quiz.reason: 非遗的价值包含代代相传的知识技能，以及创造、维护它的社区。
quiz.reason_en: Transmitted knowledge and its practising communities are central.

qa.question: 什么是非遗？
aliases: 什么是非物质文化遗产
qa.answer: 它包括由社区认同并代代传承的活态实践、表达、知识和技能。
qa.answer_en: It includes living practices, expressions, knowledge and skills recognized and transmitted by communities.

qa.question: 非遗有哪五个领域？
qa.answer: 口头传统与表达、表演艺术、社会实践仪式与节庆、有关自然和宇宙的知识实践、传统手工艺；一个项目也可能跨领域。
qa.answer_en: Oral traditions, performing arts, social practices and festivities, knowledge of nature and the universe, and traditional craftsmanship. Domains can overlap.

zones.name: 传统技艺区

narrations.child: 【基础】这一站用雕版印刷讲手艺。【背景】一个印好的图案背后有人协作。【工艺】刻好木版，再上墨把图印到纸上。【文化】观察任务：如果只留下纸，却没人会印，会少掉什么？这里不操作真实刻刀。
narrations.general: 【基础】雕版印刷让木版上的凸起文字图案着墨成印。【背景】中国雕版印刷技艺于2009年列入联合国教科文组织代表作名录。【工艺】写样、刻版、试印校正、上墨刷印相互配合。【文化】本区示意只讲方法，不指认真实馆藏。
narrations.deep: 【基础】保护手工艺，需要关注技艺和知识。【背景】成品能展示结果，却不能独自保存匠人的经验。【工艺】把校样纠错与协作也纳入观察，比较每步对成品的影响。【文化】传承培训把实践与交流结合；我们的按钮体验只提供学习线索，不能替代跟随师傅训练。

english.child: Basics: We explore block printing. Background: Makers work together. Craft: Ink a carved block and print on paper. Culture: If nobody knew how to print, what would be lost? No real cutting tools are used here.
english.general: Basics: Raised marks on a carved block carry ink. Background: This Chinese technique was inscribed in 2009. Craft: Preparing, carving, proofing and printing connect. Culture: Our demonstration explains a process, without claiming a museum object.
english.deep: Basics: Safeguard knowledge alongside products. Background: Objects cannot preserve every practical judgement. Craft: Study correction and collaboration as well as carving. Culture: Training combines practice and exchange. Buttons introduce a subject; sustained learning with practitioners develops skill.

zones.task: 按顺序说出刻版、上墨、刷印三个环节。
zones.task_en: Put carving, inking and printing in order.

quiz.question: 木版完成后，为检查问题应该先做什么？
quiz.question_en: How can makers check a carved block?

options.en: Make a proof and correct it

quiz.reason: 官方项目介绍包含试印与校正环节。
quiz.reason_en: The official description includes proofing and correction.

qa.question: 雕版印刷怎样把字印到纸上？
qa.question_en: How does block printing transfer a design?
qa.answer: 木版刻成凸起的文字图案，经过试印校正后上墨，再手工刷印到纸上。
qa.answer_en: Carved raised designs are proofed, corrected, inked and printed onto paper by hand.

qa.question: 保护传统手工艺只是保存成品吗？
qa.question_en: Is safeguarding craftsmanship only about keeping objects?
qa.answer: 还要支持手艺人继续实践，并将技能和知识教给他人。
qa.answer_en: It also means supporting artisans to practise and pass their skills and knowledge on.

zones.name: 代表作品赏析区

narrations.child: 【基础】剪纸能把纸变成好看的图案。【背景】它也走进人们的日常和民俗活动。【工艺】找一找画面里留下的纸和剪开的空处。【文化】本区是示意赏析，没有真实大师作品；你愿意用什么图案表达祝福？
narrations.general: 【基础】剪纸用剪刀或刻刀在纸上形成纹样。【背景】国家图书馆的项目介绍强调它与民俗生活的联系。【工艺】观察轮廓、疏密与留白，是本示范区的赏析任务。【文化】作品不只是装饰，也能表达生活愿望与审美情趣。
narrations.deep: 【基础】赏析要把图案放回使用情境。【背景】中国民间文艺家协会的记录工作关注创作、传播和张贴全过程。【工艺】请比较不同图案如何安排空间，不把本区图形当成某地固定规范。【文化】地域间的文化功能与纹饰可能不同，具体含义应由当地实践者及可靠资料解释。

english.child: Basics: Paper can become a picture. Background: Paper-cuts join daily and festive life. Craft: Spot the paper that remains and the spaces cut away. Culture: These are demonstration designs. What picture would you choose for a good wish?
english.general: Basics: Scissors or knives shape paper patterns. Background: The National Library connects this art with folk life. Craft: Our task explores outlines and spacing. Culture: Decoration can also express hopes and aesthetic choices.
english.deep: Basics: Consider how a design is used. Background: Documentation follows making, sharing and displaying. Craft: Compare spatial choices without treating our diagrams as regional rules. Culture: Functions and motifs vary; consult practitioners before assigning a precise meaning.

zones.task: 选择一个示意纹样，描述轮廓或留白；不要猜作者与年代。
zones.task_en: Describe a demonstration pattern's outline or spacing, without guessing an artist or date.

quiz.question: 解释一幅剪纸的文化含义，哪种做法更合适？
quiz.question_en: How should we interpret a paper-cut's cultural meaning?

options.text: 所有地方含义都完全一样
options.en: Assume all places use identical meanings

options.text: 结合当地习俗和使用情境

quiz.reason: 剪纸的地域文化功能与纹饰存在差异，不能一概而论。
quiz.reason_en: Regional functions and motifs differ; context matters.

qa.question: 剪纸通常用什么工具？
qa.question_en: What tools are used for paper-cutting?
qa.answer: 通常用剪刀或刻刀在纸上剪刻纹样；真实工具体验应由工作人员安排。
qa.answer_en: Scissors or carving knives cut patterns into paper. Staff should arrange any real tool activity.

qa.question: 各地剪纸都一样吗？
qa.answer: 不同地域的文化功能与纹饰造型存在差异，需要结合民俗与使用情境理解。
qa.answer_en: Regional functions and patterns differ and should be understood in their folk and social context.

zones.name: 历史传承区

narrations.child: 【基础】这一站讲宣纸和学手艺的人。【背景】我们把接力传授画成一条示意时间线。【工艺】树皮、稻草经过许多手工步骤才能成纸。【文化】请说一说：做纸的人和写字画画的人，怎样一起让文化延续？
narrations.general: 【基础】宣纸常用于书法、绘画与印书。【背景】宣纸传统制作技艺于2009年列入联合国教科文组织代表作名录。【工艺】青檀皮与稻草经过浸泡、制浆等手工环节。【文化】本区讲传承过程，不宣称展示了某年某人制作的真品。
narrations.deep: 【基础】传承不是只给成品标上一个年代。【背景】官方项目介绍把泾县的环境、材料和口传经验相联系。【工艺】制作需要很多工序，学习依赖长期实践。【文化】示意时间线中的名录节点说明保护行动；持续有人学习、实践和传授，才让知识进入未来。

english.child: Basics: Meet Xuan paper and its makers. Background: Our timeline pictures a learning relay. Craft: Bark and straw pass through many manual stages. Culture: How do papermakers and artists help each other keep culture alive?
english.general: Basics: Xuan paper serves calligraphy, painting and printing. Background: Its traditional craft was inscribed in 2009. Craft: Blue sandalwood bark and rice straw undergo manual processing. Culture: This display describes transmission and makes no claim about an original object.
english.deep: Basics: Transmission exceeds an object's date. Background: The official account relates Jing County's environment and inherited knowledge. Craft: Many stages require lasting practice. Culture: Inventory dates mark safeguarding actions; continued learning carries skills forward.

zones.task: 把材料、制作人、学习者三个角色连成一条传承链。
zones.task_en: Connect materials, makers and learners into a chain of transmission.

quiz.question: 宣纸传统制作的重要原料包括什么？
quiz.question_en: Which materials are used in traditional Xuan papermaking?

options.en: Blue sandalwood bark and rice straw

quiz.reason: 联合国教科文组织项目页介绍了青檀皮与稻草等原料。
quiz.reason_en: The UNESCO account identifies blue sandalwood bark and rice straw.

qa.question: 宣纸主要用来做什么？
qa.question_en: What is Xuan paper used for?
qa.answer: 它广泛用于书法、绘画和书籍印刷。
qa.answer_en: It is widely used for calligraphy, painting and book printing.

qa.question: 国家级非遗名录有什么作用？
qa.question_en: What is the purpose of China's national heritage inventory?
qa.answer: 名录确认保护对象，帮助把资源用于有重要价值的非遗项目保护。
qa.answer_en: It identifies safeguarding subjects and helps focus resources on significant heritage practices.

zones.name: 互动体验区

narrations.child: 【基础】现在把看见的变成一个小任务。【背景】学习手艺可以从兴趣开始。【工艺】请先说步骤、再做屏幕答题；真实工具要听工作人员安排。【文化】完成任务卡后，告诉同伴你最想继续学什么。答题记录只是本次体验。
narrations.general: 【基础】这一区提供离线任务卡与文字问答。【背景】非遗教育把兴趣启蒙和技能学习连接起来。【工艺】按钮帮助梳理顺序，不能代替亲手练习。【文化】我们的策展建议是尊重传承人、核对出处，并参加合适的学习活动；具体课程以工作人员说明为准。
narrations.deep: 【基础】参与式学习应能回到真实实践。【背景】传承人群培训强调秉承传统并交流学习，学校也能与传承人协作。【工艺】任务卡记录你识别的步骤和答题结果，不评价真实技艺水平。【文化】本系统只统计会话内事件，不做人脸识别或真实语音采集；需要深入学习时，请由人工引介。

english.child: Basics: Turn what you saw into a task. Background: Interest can begin learning. Craft: Describe a step and answer a screen question. Follow staff for real tools. Culture: Tell a companion what you would like to learn next.
english.general: Basics: These tasks and questions work offline. Background: Heritage education connects interest and skills. Craft: Buttons help organize steps but cannot replace practice. Culture: Our curatorial suggestion is to respect practitioners, check sources and seek suitable learning activities.
english.deep: Basics: Participation should lead toward practice. Background: Training and schools can connect learners with practitioners. Craft: Task records describe this experience, not mastery. Culture: This system records session events without face recognition or microphone capture. Staff can introduce deeper learning.

zones.task: 完成最后一题，选择一个想进一步学习的项目，向工作人员咨询。
zones.task_en: Complete the final question and ask staff about a skill you want to study.

quiz.question: 做完屏幕任务，能说明什么？
quiz.question_en: What does completing this screen task demonstrate?

options.text: 已经掌握所有真实技艺
完成一次学习体验，还可继续实践
options.en: A learning experience, with more practice ahead

quiz.reason: 手艺需要持续实践和传授；屏幕任务是本示范馆的入门活动。
quiz.reason_en: Skills need ongoing practice and transmission; this task is an introduction.

qa.question: 普通人可以怎样参与非遗学习？
qa.question_en: How can a visitor begin learning about heritage?
qa.answer: 可以从兴趣启蒙和有指导的学习活动入手。具体可参加的课程，请工作人员核实安排。
qa.answer_en: Begin with introductory and guided learning. Ask staff to verify which activities are actually available.

qa.question: 传统工艺可以和现代设计交流吗？
qa.question_en: Can traditional crafts engage with modern design?
qa.answer: 传承人群研修研习培训计划鼓励在秉承传统的基础上，通过手工实践与跨界交流提高设计制作水平。
qa.answer_en: The training programme encourages practice and exchange to develop design and making while respecting tradition.
